ios-navigation|Column views.summary: Plenix Miller columns on iPadOS and the Mac are the system column view (NavigationSplitView with three columns, or NSBrowser on the Mac), kept native in behavior (selection opens the next column, the arrow keys move between levels, VoiceOver reads each column as a list) and drawn with the Plenix list roles: rows at least 44 points tall in DM Sans, the chosen path in the Plenix selected fill and content color, a chevron on each parent, the thin subtle line between columns. On iPhone the same data is one level at a time in a NavigationStack. Apple’s default tints the chosen row in the system accent; Plenix keeps the structure and replaces the colors and type.
